text:
Raya: Quick sync  proposed lightweight 'fallthrough' protocol for admin cleanups: if a principal is flagged by KMS grants + no last_used for 120d -> auto-create a mitigation ticket instead of immediate revoke. Thoughts?
Omar: 👍 sounds safe. Do we include a retention indicator so reviewers know when logs are partial?
Raya: Yes, output will include `audit_coverage` (365/90/30) per project. If coverage <90d flag as evidence_limited.
Tessa: Also add cross-project marker. Cross-project admins need product-owner signoff.
Ben: For CI principals we should not auto-close tickets. Mark them as "requires migration plan" and add a checklist: rotate key, run staging smoke tests, update credential store.
Raya: Example log selector I used for the pilot: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "CreateGrant" OR "Decrypt")' --freshness=120d --format=json --project=redwood-prod`
Omar: policy-bot: can you enrich CSVs with runbook links and a prefilled JIRA JSON when given principals?
policy-bot: Drop CSV to /tmp/fallthrough with columns (principal_id,project,flag_reason). I will return a reviewer bundle that includes runbook links, a JIRA payload, and a suggested mitigation timeline based on score.
Tessa: Redaction note: mask emails in initial export (principal:sha256) and keep an internal lookup for security-only.
Ben: Action items: Raya will push the query + redaction script to infra-reports by Fri; Omar will add audit_coverage; Tessa will draft CI checklist; I'll draft the migration ticket template.
Raya: Goal: pilot <=200 items and zero emergency rollbacks. Will post the CSV and request 3 reviewers next week. :thumbsup:
